## Quarto

Quarto enables you to weave together content and executable code into a finished document. To learn more about Quarto see <https://quarto.org>.

## Running Code

When you click the **Render** button a document will be generated that includes both content and the output of embedded code. You can embed code like this:

```{r}
1 + 1
```

You can add options to executable code like this

```{r}

library(tidyverse)

# Assume your data looks like this (one row per site):
# site, sand, silt, clay
# "0.5", 12, 51, 37
# "2", 8, 50, 42
# ...

grainsize <- read_csv("C:\\Users\\savan\\OneDrive - San Francisco State University\\ProjectData\\GitHub\\DepositionSFB\\data\\soil_scrape.csv")  

grainsize <- grainsize %>%
  mutate(across(c(Sand, Silt, Clay), ~ as.numeric(str_replace(., "<1", "0"))))

# Reshape to long format for ggplot
grainsize_long <- grainsize %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c("Sand", "Silt", "Clay"),
    names_to = "grain_size",
    values_to = "percent"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    grain_size = factor(grain_size, levels = c("Clay", "Silt", "Sand"))
    # order controls stacking order (bottom to top reversed in ggplot legend)
  )



ggplot(grainsize_long, aes(x = Dist, y = percent, fill = grain_size)) +
  geom_col(position = "stack", width = 0.9) +
  facet_wrap(vars(Tran, Site)) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c(Sand = "#5B9BD5", Silt = "#ED7D31", Clay = "#A5A5A5"),
    name = "Grain size"
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Percent Composition of Grain Size Per Site",
    x = "Site",
    y = "Percent Composition of Grain Size (%)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, vjust = 0.5, hjust = 1, size = 6),
    panel.grid.major.x = element_blank()
  )


```

```{r, mean percentages per site}

grainsize_siteavg <- grainsize_long %>% group_by(Site, grain_size) %>% summarise(percent = mean(percent, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

p_siteavg = ggplot(grainsize_siteavg, aes(x = Site, y = percent, fill = grain_size)) + geom_col(position = "stack", width = 0.9) + scale_fill_manual( values = c(Sand = "#5B9BD5", Silt = "#ED7D31", Clay = "#A5A5A5"), name = "Grain size" ) + labs( title = "Average Percent Composition of Grain Size Per Site", x = "Site", y = "Average Percent (%)" ) + theme_minimal() + theme( axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, vjust = 0.5, hjust = 1, size = 6), panel.grid.major.x = element_blank() )

ggsave(
  filename = file.path(out_dir, "grainsize_site_averages.png"),
  plot = p_siteavg, width = 10, height = 6, dpi = 300
)


grainsize_tranavg <- grainsize_long %>% group_by(Site, Tran, grain_size) %>% summarise(percent = mean(percent, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

p_tranavg = ggplot(grainsize_tranavg, aes(x = factor(Tran), y = percent, fill = grain_size)) + 
  facet_wrap(~Site) +
  geom_col(position = "stack", width = 0.9) + scale_fill_manual( values = c(Sand = "#5B9BD5", Silt = "#ED7D31", Clay = "#A5A5A5"), name = "Grain size" ) + labs( title = "Average Percent Composition of Grain Size Per Site", x = "Site", y = "Average Percent (%)" ) + theme_minimal() + theme( axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, vjust = 0.5, hjust = 1, size = 6), panel.grid.major.x = element_blank() )


ggsave(
  filename = file.path(out_dir, "grainsize_transect_averages_by_site.png"),
  plot = p_tranavg, width = 10, height = 6, dpi = 300
)

```

```{r, saving each of the grain size graphs}

out_dir <- "C:/Users/savan/OneDrive - San Francisco State University/ProjectData/GitHub/DepositionSFB/images/soilcores"

dir.create(out_dir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

site_tran_combos <- grainsize_long %>% distinct(Tran, Site)

for (i in seq_len(nrow(site_tran_combos))) {
  this_tran <- site_tran_combos$Tran[i]
  this_site <- site_tran_combos$Site[i]
  
  p <- grainsize_long %>%
    filter(Tran == this_tran, Site == this_site) %>%
    ggplot(aes(x = Dist, y = percent, fill = grain_size)) +
    geom_col(position = "stack", width = 0.9) +
    scale_fill_manual(
      values = c(Sand = "#5B9BD5", Silt = "#ED7D31", Clay = "#A5A5A5"),
      name = "Grain size"
    ) +
    labs(
      title = paste("Percent Composition —", this_site, "Transect", this_tran),
      x = "Distance (m)", y = "Percent Composition Grain Size (%)"
    ) +
    theme_minimal()
  
  ggsave(
    filename = file.path(out_dir, paste0("grainsize_", this_site, "_T", this_tran, ".png")),
    plot = p, width = 10, height = 6, dpi = 300
  )
}
```
